newsitem.title: FRANCE: SEB sees 1997 profit up around 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: SEB sees 1997 profit up around 10 pct.

text.p: French appliance manufacturer SEB expects a profit rise this year of around 10 percent, chairman Jacques Gairard told the annual shareholders meeting on Monday.
SEB reported a 1996 profit of 480 million francs, compared with 450 million for the preceding year.
"If growth is confirmed, the current year could show an improvement in results of around 10 percent," Gairard said.
For the first three months of 1997, the group has already announced an increase in turnover of 12 percent, or nine percent at constant exchange rates.
Gairard said he expected global expansion to accelerate due to recent openings in Russia, Turkey, China, India, Brazil and Argentina. The group also planned new projects in Asia this year, he said.
Sales outside France should account for more than 70 percent of the total this year, and sales outside of the European Union should account for nearly 40 percent, Gairard said.
